anti_generic_signature_read: The nested parent-and-chick characters make the mechanism specific: the removable chick is simultaneously the depicted subject and the visible actuator beneath the owl.
blind_action_read: The chick moves and rocks left through center to right while the owl changes to materially opposite angles, visibly alternating the planted and lifted feet around a near-level center state.
blind_form_read: The ISO reads as a volumetric, chunky, deliberately low-poly desk object with deep constant sections, recessed facial marks, broad legs, and a faceted nested insert rather than a flat plaque or technical test.
blind_held_read: A coherent thick printable two-part character object: a substantial peaked outer animal frame with a smaller rounded character nested in its lower opening.
blind_relationship_read: The nested chick appears to support the belly at changing lateral points, making the causal chain chick rolls, support shifts, owl rocks onto the opposite foot understandable.
blind_subjects_read: The large character reads as an owl through its paired brow and eye arcs, central beak, and peaked head; the smaller rounded beaked character reads as a chick.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The ISO and all three states visibly contain only the single continuous owl frame and the single continuous contrasting nested chick, with no third hardware element.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Exactly two printed parts: one owl and one removable chick cam.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The hero shows the owl as a compact thick-bodied object with paired facial arcs, beak, peaked head, deep side faces, and two broad full-depth legs; the state sheet makes both foot landings explicit.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: A friendly palm-sized owl about 80 by 68 by 24 mm with a clear chunky silhouette, broad stable feet, and a flat print back.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Every state visibly keeps the rounded beaked chick upright within the rectangular belly opening and inside the owl's overall silhouette.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: A small rounded triangular chick cam stays upright and nested inside the owl's open belly.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The fixed-view sequence shows chick left, centered, and right with corresponding left-tilted, level, and right-tilted owl poses and opposite planted feet.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: One thumb roll carries the chick left to right under the belly bridge and visibly transfers the owl from one broad foot to the other.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The chick visibly changes rocking attitude beneath the broad belly bridge while the owl rises through the centered state and settles oppositely at each endpoint.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The chick's rounded cam edge is the visible load-bearing contact that raises the body before the opposite foot lands.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The open belly, full-depth side stop walls, daylight around the chick faces and sides, and three non-colliding endpoint poses are clearly visible; the exact gap is bound separately by the passing preflight and CAD measurements.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Broad endpoint stops and open 0.8 mm running gaps keep contact visible and loose.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: All three exact poses retain the chick beneath the owl with no exploded part, detached state, or overturned character.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Both parts remain upright and nested throughout the repeatable out-and-back cycle.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The open ISO and state views show only two solid characters meeting through exposed surfaces, with no axle, fastener, wire, enclosure, snap arm, weight cavity, or flexing member visible.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: No axle, glue, electronics, hidden supports, snap fit, ballast, or forced-flexure mechanism.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Friendly family-matched faces, warm color, chunky finished surfaces, and the immediately demonstrable three-state stomp make the object giftable and interaction-specific.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The result must read as a desirable finished desk toy rather than a generic primitive or decorative object without repeatable interaction.

largest_risk: Physical printing is still required to verify that real friction and center of mass consistently produce smooth rolling, stable endpoint landings, and reliable foot lift without binding or sliding.
resolution: The second render family grounds the active foot at a shared tabletop datum, increases the owl endpoints to opposite five-degree tilts, rotates the chick with its rolling direction, and preserves a neutral centered pose so the roll-to-stomp chain is visually explicit.
